prompt:
Create ONE native ULTRAWIDE landscape product photograph for the first frame of a website hero video.

OUTPUT CANVAS IS THE PRIMARY REQUIREMENT: aspect ratio exactly 75:32, equivalent to 2250 x 960 pixels, approximately 2.34375:1. This is visibly wider and shallower than 16:9. The actual website frame is 937.5 x 400 CSS pixels. Fill this entire ultrawide canvas with the real scene; no letterboxing, no top or bottom bands, no added border, no inset picture, no collage.

The attached image is a real existing website thumbnail, to be used ONLY as the complete contents of the tablet display. It is the Furin Kasan site, whose supplied Japanese logo reads 風林花山. Preserve the provided screenshot's red header, original title artwork, three adult fantasy characters, shrine and cherry-blossom background, seven game thumbnails and bottom navigation. Show the entire reference within the display with its original relative layout and natural proportions; do not invent a new website, new characters, extra UI, or replace this with CAT VILLAGE. Do not put any part of this artwork outside the screen.

Photograph one beautiful unbranded graphite tablet in LANDSCAPE orientation, with a wide display close to the attached screenshot's 1000:563 aspect ratio, a slim intact dark bezel and softly rounded physical corners. The tablet rests upright on a low pale limestone surface in a bright, airy architectural studio. Camera almost straight on with only a subtle five-degree horizontal perspective, screen clean and easy to see. All four physical tablet edges and all four screen edges must be fully visible. The device is not cut off anywhere.

FRAMING FOR SAFE VIDEO MOTION: the entire tablet body occupies about 58 to 60 percent of the canvas height. Keep its top at approximately 20 percent of canvas height and its bottom at approximately 80 percent. Place its center at approximately 58 percent of canvas width. Give it generous clear space above, below, left and right for a later moderate camera push-in. Do NOT make the tablet fill the image vertically and do NOT crop the top or bottom of the device. The extra-wide room should be visible around it, not a close-up of the display. Keep the full device and screen in a shallow horizontal composition.

Soft bright window light from the upper left, warm-white and pale pearl-gray architectural surfaces, a quiet softly blurred horizontal glass panel in the far background, natural gentle contact shadow below the tablet, restrained metallic edge highlights. Sophisticated physical product photography with a real screen inside the hardware, not an illustration or floating UI. The displayed thumbnail retains its own original rich colors; the surrounding studio remains light and neutral. Crisp screen image, no dark veil or strong glare covering it.

Static first frame. One tablet only. No phone, no hands, no people in the room, no extra devices, no floating graphics, no added typography or watermark outside the supplied screen image, no orange lighting, no motion blur. Return ONE complete 75:32 ultrawide image.
